verdict.rationale: The docs say the `wezterm cli` subcommand can drive a running GUI or multiplexer instance to spawn programs and manipulate tabs and panes. A hands-on runtime probe confirmed a fully headless control loop with no GUI session: `wezterm-mux-server --daemonize`, then CLI spawn, send-text, get-text and list. A community user also corroborates using get-text to dump pane contents to stdout. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the mux-server headless mode itself, and CI-specific guidance or examples (containers, exit-code and scripting behavior).
